table.retrieve:
SELECT saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
		 CustomerRef = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo, 
		itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=max(item.icatcode)),
       date        = CASE lower(:as_datetype)  
				 					When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
									When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
									When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
							  End ,    
       invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,    
       flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,    
       misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
       invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
       remarks = dbo.saleledger.remarks,
       custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode,
		 manufacturer = max(dbo.manufacturer.name),
		 looseqty = sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty), 
		 bonusqty = sum(dbo.saledetail.bonusqty), 
		 itemflatdisc=max(dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),
       packqty  = sum(saledetail.packqty),  
       packing = case when dbo.item.packcode IS null Then space(30) else max(dbo.itempacking.name) end,
       price =max( dbo.saledetail.saleprice),    
       itemdiscperc = max(dbo.saledetail.discperc),    
		 packunits = max(dbo.saledetail.packunits),    
		 batch = max(dbo.saledetail.batch),    
		 expiry = max(dbo.saledetail.expiry),    
		 salestax  =max( saledetail.salestax),
		 rowid     = max(saledetail.rowid),
	 	 itemname = CASE max(SaleDetail.Claimable) When 'Y' THEN max(dbo.itempacking.name) Else item.name END,
		 itemalias = max(item.customicode),
		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
		 Person = dbo.accounts.name ,
		 address1 =max( dbo.customer.address1),
		 address2 = max(dbo.customer.address2),
		 city = max(dbo.customer.city),
		 phone = max(dbo.customer.phone), 	
      doctype = Case max(dbo.saleledger.salecatcode) When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End,
		
		 invnettotal= (SELECT 
                    amountfg = Round( 
                                     Sum (  SD.looseqty *  SD.saleprice)    
			                            -  Round(Sum (Round((  SD.looseqty  * ( SD.saleprice -  SD.itemflatdisc) * ( SD.discperc * .01)) + ( SD.looseqty  *  SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)    
    		                            - Round(Sum (  SD.looseqty   * ( SD.saleprice  -  SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - ( SD.discperc * .01))) * ( SL.discperc /100), 2)
												 + misccharges - flatdisc,0)
			
    			 FROM dbo.saleledger SL , 
         			dbo.saledetail SD

   			 WHERE  (SL.saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode )   and
						  (SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode )   
         
				 GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,   
							 SL.misccharges,   
         				 SL.flatdisc,   
							 SL.discperc,  
		   			  	 SL.salestax 
			)


FROM 	 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking  ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.manufacturer,
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.customer
WHERE 
	CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
		When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
	End Between :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
	dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:al_custcode) AND
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
	dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode and 
	item.manfcode = manufacturer.manfcode and
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and
	dbo.accounts.acccode = dbo.customer.custcode
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.originaldate,
	saleledger.billingdate,
	/*saleledger.headerno,*/
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks,
	saleledger.custrefno, 
	saledetail.icode,
	saledetail.rowgroup, 
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.packcode,
	item.icode,
	item.printable, 
	accounts.name
UNION ALL
SELECT saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
		 CustomerRef = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo, 
		itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=max(item.icatcode)),
       date        = CASE lower(:as_datetype)  
				 					When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
									When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
									When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
							  End ,    
       invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,    
       flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,    
       misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
       invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
       remarks = dbo.saleledger.remarks,
       custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode,
		 manufacturer = max(dbo.manufacturer.name),
		 looseqty = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
		 bonusqty = sum(saledetail.bonusqty), 
		 itemflatdisc=max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
       packqty  = 0,  
       packing = case when dbo.item.packcode IS null Then space(30) else max(dbo.itempacking.name) end,
       price =max( saledetail.saleprice),    
       itemdiscperc = max(saledetail.discperc),    
		 packunits = max(saledetail.packunits),    
		 batch = max(saledetail.batch),    
		 expiry = max(saledetail.expiry),    
		 salestax  =0,
		 rowid     = max(saledetail.rowid),
	 	 itemname = item.name,
		 itemalias = max(item.customicode),
		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
		 Person = dbo.accounts.name ,
		 address1 =max( dbo.customer.address1),
		 address2 = max(dbo.customer.address2),
		 city = max(dbo.customer.city),
		 phone = max(dbo.customer.phone), 	
      doctype = Case max(dbo.saleledger.salecatcode) When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End,
		
		 invnettotal= (SELECT 
                    amountfg = Round( 
                                     Sum (  SD.looseqty *  SD.saleprice)    
			                            -  Round(Sum (Round((  SD.looseqty  * ( SD.saleprice -  SD.itemflatdisc) * ( SD.discperc * .01)) + ( SD.looseqty  *  SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)    
    		                            - Round(Sum (  SD.looseqty   * ( SD.saleprice  -  SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - ( SD.discperc * .01))) * ( SL.discperc /100), 2)
												 + misccharges - flatdisc,0)
			
    			 FROM dbo.saleledger SL , 
         			dbo.saleinvdetail SD

   			 WHERE  (SL.saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode )   and
						  (SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode )   
         
				 GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,   
							 SL.misccharges,   
         				 SL.flatdisc,   
							 SL.discperc,  
		   			  	 SL.salestax 
			)
FROM
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saleinvdetail saledetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking  ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.manufacturer,
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.customer
WHERE  
	DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
	CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
		When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
	End Between :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
	dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:al_custcode) AND
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and  
	saledetail.icode = item.icode and 
	item.manfcode = manufacturer.manfcode and
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and
	dbo.accounts.acccode = dbo.customer.custcode
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode,       
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.originaldate,
	saleledger.billingdate,
	/*saleledger.headerno,*/
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks,
	saleledger.custrefno, 
	saledetail.icode,
	saledetail.rowgroup, 
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.packcode,
	item.icode,
	item.printable, 
	accounts.name
ORDER BY 	
	person,
	saleinvcode,
	itemname,
	rowid
table.sort: person A, saleinvcode A, itemname A, rowid A

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round(((  looseqty   *  price  ) - (looseqty  *  itemflatdisc)) *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )  , 2)

objects.name: c_itemdiscount
objects.expression: Round (  looseqty  * ( price  -  itemflatdisc)  *  ( itemdiscperc *  .01 ) , 2) +( itemflatdisc* looseqty)

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(  c_amount for group 1 ) + sum(misccharges for group 1 distinct   saleinvcode ) - sum(flatdisc for group 1 distinct   saleinvcode ), 0)

objects.name: c_invdiscount
objects.expression: Sum (( ((  looseqty   *  price  )   - (looseqty * itemflatdisc) )*  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) for group 2 )  *  ( Sum(invdiscperc for group 2 distinct saleinvcode) * .01)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round ( (Sum(((  looseqty   *  price  ) - (looseqty  *  itemflatdisc)) *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )  For Group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 ) ) -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)
